audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 is assigned to Gangplank in both layers while its own why, spike and mid text all say the stage is roughly even; 2+ items is assigned to Dr. Mundo while whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say full-build Gangplank flips it back. whys[4] and whys[5] are also shifted one row out of phase with their labels.
audit.why: Dr. Mundo wins 53.55% over 2560 games from the early-to-mid window, not the late game; the packet chart gives Level 6 to Skill and 2+ items to Gangplank, which is what every prose field on the page already argues and what a 9.5/10 carry rating implies.
audit.corrected: Level 6 Skill, First item Dr. Mundo, 2+ items Gangplank, with ratings and whys matched.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns given for the two abilities the advice depends on: Remove Scurvy 22/20/18/16/14 and Cannon Barrage 160/140/120.
audit.why: 'Bait his W' is unusable without knowing you get a 22-second window at rank 1, and his 160s rank-1 ult is why level 6 is a map spike rather than a duel spike.
audit.corrected: 22s W and 160s R written into the level 3-5 spike, the early text and whys[4].
sources: champ-data/_kits gangplank W cd 22/20/18/16/14, R cd 160/140/120

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states that Remove Scurvy cures crowd control — it removes the Infected Bonesaw slow, which is Dr. Mundo's only tool for holding him in a walk-down — and nothing calls for Grievous Wounds against the heal on the same button. 'Q sustain' is again credited to Infected Bonesaw, which heals nothing.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Eats citrus to cure crowd control effects and restore Health.' Mundo has no dash, so the Q slow is the entire chase; a cleanse on a 22s cooldown at rank 1 decides whether the walk-down ever connects.
audit.corrected: Remove Scurvy named as a cleanse-plus-heal on 22s that must be baited before committing; Grievous Wounds tied to the first-item timing; healing re-attributed to Heart Zapper's end-of-duration burst.

edits.before: At 3 your Q sustain and E punish flip the lane in your favour.
edits.after: At 3 Heart Zapper's heal and Blunt Force flip the lane to you.

edits.before: At 5 it's even — his barrel burst threatens through your regen.
edits.after: At 6 his 160s Cannon Barrage is a map tool, not a duel — Skill.

edits.before: Level 6 leans to you in lane; his R is a global tool, not a duel win.
edits.after: First item's HP stack beats his barrel chip in lane — Dr. Mundo.

edits.before: After the poke-heavy first two levels you stabilize: Q Infected Bonesaw sustains through his Parrrley harass and E Blunt Force Trauma lets you punish when he steps up to last-hit with barrels. Kill his W Remove Scurvy timing by baiting it, and detonate his barrel chains early by standing on them.
edits.after: After the poke-heavy first two levels you stabilize: Heart Zapper's burst heals you back through Parrrley chip and Blunt Force punishes his step-up. Remove Scurvy (W) cures crowd control and heals on a 22s cooldown at rank 1 — it wipes your bonesaw slow, so bait it before you commit to the walk-down.

edits.before: Your first item spikes you ahead of his early barrel damage. Walk him down when his barrels are on cooldown and force short trades where your Q-E out-damages his Parrrley chip.
edits.after: Your first item spikes you ahead of his barrel damage. Walk him down when the chain is spent, and buy Grievous Wounds here — Remove Scurvy is the heal that rescues him from a trade he already lost.

edits.before: Gangplank pokes you down at levels 1-2 with Parrrley and barrel harass, so soak minimal poke and farm. By level 3 you stabilize — Q Infected Bonesaw sustains his chip and E Blunt Force Trauma punishes any barrel step-up. Detonate his chains early by standing on the barrels and trade when they're down.
edits.after: Gangplank pokes you at levels 1-2 with Parrrley and barrel harass, so soak minimal poke and farm. By level 3 you stabilize — Heart Zapper's end burst heals you back and Blunt Force punishes any barrel step-up. Detonate his chains early by standing on them, and remember Remove Scurvy cures your slow every 22s.
